answeredQuestions.initiative-name: Proper Warm Retrofit Programme Demonstrator and Platform Assessment
answeredQuestions.business-context: Draft a product requirements document for a non-production retrofit programme demonstrator and platform comparison, derived from BRD-2026-AMA48-001 version 0.6.0.
answeredQuestions.option-set: Compare full Azure custom development, business apps (Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, Copilot Studio and SharePoint; Dynamics 365 only if present), and an Azure control plane with M365 collaboration/documents and optional Copilot Studio channels.
answeredQuestions.owner-platform-preference: The owner prefers Azure for the AMA capstone and Solution Architect practice, but requested objective assessment of all options. This is not a customer platform decision.
answeredQuestions.role-profile-review: All eight company-* role profiles were asked for a role-specific challenge on 2026-10-03. Their responses are sector-informed hypotheses and unknowns, not company facts, resident evidence or approvals.
answeredQuestions.mvp-boundary: Proposed non-production, synthetic-data demonstrator; compare all options consistently and build only the candidate authorized at a platform decision gate. No production integrations, live resident contact or operational authority.
answeredQuestions.prd-boundary-confirmation: Owner directed the PRD to use the Azure-led hybrid approach and confirmed current coordination uses Excel files only, with no Dataverse or Dynamics 365. Treat hybrid as the proposed demonstrator baseline; retain full Azure and greenfield business apps as comparators. M365/SharePoint tenancy, licences and governance remain unverified.
answeredQuestions.role-profile-open-question-synthesis: Each of the eight company-* role profiles completed a second-pass review of the hybrid baseline on 2026-10-03 and raised one focused open question from its perspective (Asset Executive, Retrofit Programme Manager, Finance and Grants, Procurement and Contracts, Data and Performance, Building Safety, Neighbourhood Housing Officer, Resident Engagement). Synthesized into an eight-row Open Questions register (OQ-001 to OQ-008) in the PRD, labelled as role-profile discovery prompts/hypotheses, not company facts or approvals. Also corrected overstated 'Excel-only' language in four places to 'Excel-based current coordination; other systems and authority unknown'.
answeredQuestions.rubric-aligned-review-pass: Reviewed the PRD against BRD v0.7.0 (including the new Owner-Provided Direction on Sponsor Discovery Questions subsection) and the AMA rubric/assessment guide. Added, for non-live repo-evidence criteria only: Component Contracts and Failure Domains (A1), an illustrative Threat Model (A3), a log-schema/correlation-ID/named-SLO-method observability design (A5), an AI Model Selection and Evaluation Harness section (A6), an Agent Orchestration Pattern section (A7), and an Options Gate Scoring Framework with DD-005/DD-006 (D1). Added candidate FR-014/AC-016 for a missed-appointment escalation route traced to owner direction, kept explicitly unratified. Added an Owner-direction cross-references subsection narrowing but not closing OQ-002/003/004/006, and a new Risk Register row warning that owner direction must not be mistaken for verified or ratified evidence. Did not attempt to move A4, D3, or any live (B1-B5, C2) criterion, since those require an actual working demonstrator or a live panel session, not PRD edits.
answeredQuestions.prd-brd-v0-12-alignment: Compared the PRD with BRD v0.12.0 RULE-006/AC-025. Updated candidate synthetic-only FR-014/AC-016 for configurable threshold, provisional default five, strict > comparator, verified resident no-access eligibility, separate excluded outcomes, active-case counting, human-closure reset with audit retention, no refusal inference and urgent-hazard bypass. Added OQ-009 for company appointment evidence, Housing/Repairs ratification, Resident Engagement review and configuration governance; preserved all open approval and handoff gates. The owner confirmed FR-014 should be exercised in synthetic acceptance tests only. Bumped PRD to v0.5.0. No signed BRD_TO_PRD_HANDOFF_V1 or valid v0.12.0 BRD quality report is available; PRD remains draft.
answeredQuestions.fr014-synthetic-test-scope: Exercise the provisional RULE-006 behavior in synthetic acceptance tests only; do not enable operational use before company ratification under OD-40.

referencesProcessed.keyFindings: BRD v0.12.0 RULE-006/AC-025 specifies configurable threshold, provisional default five, strict greater-than trigger, only confirmed appointments with verified resident no-access counted while the case is active, separate excluded outcomes for provider/contractor no-shows, cancellations and reschedules, counter reset only on human closure with audit history retained, human investigation without assuming refusal, and no delay to urgent hazard response. Public evidence does not validate five; company ratification and configuration governance remain open under OD-40.

userPreferences.fr014-synthetic-test-scope: Owner confirms exercise the provisional RULE-006 behavior in synthetic acceptance tests only; this is not operational or company policy approval.
userPreferences.whole-workbench-workflow-coverage-2026-1: Rewrite the existing PRD as one role-based retrofit workbench spanning all nine BRD workflows, with profile-specific screens over shared data, new/priority/stale/attention queues, individual and permitted multi-case edits, traceable handoffs and returns/reopens, coordinator heatmap/funnel/timeline/uncertainty-aware forecasts, and bounded source-linked next-step suggestions. One PRD is retained because workflows share case, authority, handoff and evidence foundations.
userPreferences.rubric-regression-restoration-2026-10-06: The Capstone Rubric Scorer run 37377066834 and PR #20 feedback identified deleted design evidence for A1/A3/A5/A6/A7. Restored component contracts and failure domains, illustrative threat model, OpenTelemetry-aligned observability/SLO measurement method, AI model evaluation harness, bounded-agent orchestration and proposed options gate. Also restored the owner-directed missed-appointment behavior as candidate synthetic-only FR-031/AC-033. These are design proposals, not implementation/results or operational approval.
userPreferences.platform-preference: Owner requested the hybrid as PRD demonstrator baseline and confirmed Excel-based coordination with no Dataverse/Dynamics; other systems and authority unknown. Retain the other options as comparators. This is not production or procurement approval.
userPreferences.prd-scope: One PRD for the role-based Proper Warm retrofit workbench; workflow areas are modules and release increments over shared cases, permissions, handoffs and evidence, not separate products.
userPreferences.rubric-regression-restoration: Restore deleted A1/A3/A5/A6/A7 design evidence without reversing the expanded nine-workflow workbench or claiming implementation or validation results.
